handoff.salientSummary: Implemented efficient pagination for large result sets (10,000+ predictions) by creating a composite database index on (evaluation_id, question_index) for the predictions table. The existing handler and repository code already supported pagination with page/limit parameters, returning correct total count and pages calculation. Added migration file to create the index.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created database migration (003_add_pagination_indexes.sql) that adds a composite index on predictions(evaluation_id, question_index) for efficient LIMIT/OFFSET pagination. The existing handler (GetResults) already supports pagination via predictions_page and predictions_limit query parameters, returning PredictionsPage with predictions array, total count, page, limit, and pages calculation. Repository method GetByEvaluationID uses LIMIT/OFFSET with proper offset calculation ((page-1)*limit) and ORDER BY question_index ASC for consistent ordering.
